components.name: Primary Download Button
components.description: Primary macOS download CTA in Shotlate Cobalt.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--cobalt, #1363d6); color: #fff; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.14s ease, transform 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--cobalt-hover, #0e52b6); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1363d6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Outlined Button
components.description: Windows companion download and secondary action button.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #121622; border: 1px solid #b6c2d3; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.14s ease, border-color 0.14s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #edf1f6; border-color: #636e82; }

components.name: Selection Dimension Pill
components.description: Calibrated coordinate badge pinned above active selection apertures.
components.css: .ds-dim-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 11px; border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0; background: #1363d6; color: #fff; font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Floating Pure-Icon Toolbar
components.description: Signature Shotlate toolbar pill straddling the bottom border of the selection aperture.
components.css: .ds-toolbar { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; padding: 6px 10px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #cbd5e3; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 10px 26px rgba(18, 22, 34, 0.13); } .ds-toolbar button { width: 34px; height: 34px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #121622; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toolbar button.is-active { background: #1363d6; color: #fff; }

narrative.overview: Shotlate's website speaks in the exact visual grammar of the macOS utility itself: opening the landing page feels like pressing ⌥A to freeze a screen region. Cool dimmed desktop mist holds a razor-sharp cobalt selection marquee with eight square handles, calibrated 1px pixel rulers along the edges, a pure-white active demonstration stage, and Shotlate's floating pure-icon toolbar pill straddling the bottom border.
keyCharacteristics: Calibrated 1px top and left pixel coordinate rulers framing the hero selection canvas.
Pure-white illuminated selection apertures bordered in Shotlate Cobalt with eight square control handles.
Real keyboard-responsive proof (Y, X, 1–7, T, S, G) inside the hero stage.
High-contrast obsidian telemetry proof band anchoring real footprint numbers alongside an explicit anti-bloat list.

rules.name: The Single-Highlight Rule
rules.body: Shotlate Cobalt owns interactive focus and selection geometry; Annotation Vermilion appears only on actual screenshot callout overlays.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Headings carry their own authority without small uppercase kickers stacked above them.

rules.name: The Hairline-First Rule
rules.body: Never add diffuse shadows to static sections, tables, or spec strips; reserve elevation for floating toolbars and window specimens.

dos: Do show real app-rendered screenshots, videos, shortcuts, and verified footprint figures (5.9 MB, ~55 MB).
Do keep tabular numerals on all coordinates, specs, and shortcut tables.
Do preserve keyboard responsiveness (Y, X, 1–7, T, S, G) and visible focus outlines.
donts: Don't add generic icon-title-paragraph card grids, decorative glassmorphism, neon glows, or eyebrow labels above headings.
Don't fabricate download counts, user testimonials, or removed features.
Don't use Annotation Vermilion for non-annotation UI chrome or primary CTAs.
